sections.title: QDB workbench
sections.description: Local FastAPI service, Postgres, and the principal token the host mints for every /internal call. Secrets stay in OS storage, not settings.json.

fields.label: Runtime mode
fields.description: Local Python uses the selected interpreter. Docker publishes the same HTTP API on 127.0.0.1.

fields.label: Python interpreter
fields.description: Used to run uvicorn app.main:app from the bundled python/ tree.

fields.label: Docker image
fields.description: Leave empty to build certiqs-qdb:local from the extension Dockerfile.

fields.label: DATABASE_URL
fields.description: Postgres connection string (pooler host for Neon). Required to start the API.

fields.label: INTERNAL_AUTH_SECRET
fields.description: HS256 secret shared with FastAPI. Empty generates and stores one on first start.

fields.label: Neon HTTP fallback
fields.description: DEV-ONLY. Reads work; create/resync need a real Postgres connection.

fields.label: Principal user id
fields.description: Asserted as JWT sub. Empty uses a workspace-stable id.

fields.label: Admin principal
fields.description: Allows catalogue writes and all-system visibility. The API still 403s non-admin tokens.

fields.label: Neo4j URI
fields.description: Optional. Not consumed by the FastAPI engines.

fields.label: Anthropic API key
fields.description: Optional. Not consumed by the FastAPI engines.

sections.title: Development
sections.description: Compile this extension and restart the running certiqs IDE extension host.

fields.label: certiqs IDE (Hot Reload)
fields.description: Default compound. scripts/run-debug.sh starts watch if needed.

fields.label: Refresh extension host
fields.description: scripts/refresh-extensions.sh qdb — compile certiqs-qdb and restart the running certiqs IDE extension host.
